issues.next: Find an applicable written correction or issuer clarification.

issues.label: Kaski chemical fertilizer rates
issues.evidence: Section 14(b) directs users to a Government of Nepal rate. The national procedure distinguishes import-point, depot and outlet prices, and Pokhara publishes a city-specific farmer outlet price. The older city rates are also limited to Pokhara. FY 2081/82 PDF p31 uses the same national-rate cross-reference.
issues.next: Obtain an applicable government or district order specifying the price tier, product and effective period for the Kaski entry.
